name: GPU-based Mesh Decimation via Edge Collapse
definition: A mesh simplification technique that reduces vertex count by iteratively collapsing edges, implemented on GPU using Thrust and CUDA kernels. It supports only triangular faces.
summary: GPU-based Mesh Decimation via Edge Collapse is a postprocessing technique that reduces polygon counts while preserving sharp features, using limited parallel iterations for significant speedups over CPU-based greedy decimation.
